learning_outcomes.text: Describe the hierarchical organisation of the human body from cells to organ systems and apply standard anatomical terminology
Explain homeostasis and common feedback mechanisms that maintain the body's internal environment
Summarise the structure and core functions of the major organ systems
Relate tissue types and their properties to the organs they build
Trace the flow of blood, air and nerve signals through their respective systems
Use correct directional, regional and sectional terms to locate structures

integrative_case: A first-year health-sciences student is asked to explain to a study group how the body keeps blood glucose, temperature and fluid balance stable at the same time; they must map each to the organ systems involved, name the feedback mechanism, and show where the systems interact.
